PLAN_MODE_CLAUSE: Don't enter plan mode unless asked to plan.
TRACK_CHUNK: Track each chunk in the task list (TaskCreate).
MATCH_SPECIALIST: Specialist knowledge (python, react, cdk, go, ship, ...) loads as skills when the work matches; it does not need a subagent.
COLLAB_SECTION: - Use subagents to isolate context, not to match specialisms: `research`, `audit`, `diagnose` and `test` are the agents. Launch independent ones in a single message, in the background for long runs.
- Agents share no context, so give each a self-contained prompt (paths, constraints, expected output), then check their results together. Tightly coupled work stays sequential.
